summary.text: Vincent Collis is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against independent Lucas Hewitt.
A software engineer and farmer in Waterloo, he advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Vincent Collis graduated from Teaneck High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Seton Hall University in 2010; his career experience includes working as a software engineer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in New York City by a public school teacher, studied Public Relations and Journalism at Seton Hall, and is pursuing a master's degree in Computer Engineering and Cyber Security at Iowa State University.

He said he has spent the last decade building tools that help Democratic candidates connect with voters, and that he and his wife, Kristina Cook-Collis, settled in her hometown of Waterloo, where he joined his father-in-law in running the family farm.

Collis's survey answers listed three priorities: keeping rural hospitals open and expanding mental health services, working with family farmers to protect Iowa's water, and fully funding public schools.
